product: Stillroom — a booking workspace for independent ceramic studios
audience: Studio owners considering a simpler way to publish workshops and manage bookings
primary_task: Understand the booking workflow, compare the plan, and open a clearly labeled demo
stack: React with the existing project's framework
scope: SaaS landing page and a working local booking demo; no payments or real booking confirmations
direction: Quiet, tactile studio identity with clear editorial hierarchy and authentic product views. Adapt a coherent set of blocks rather than mixing unrelated hero sections.
acceptance: A visitor understands who the product serves and what the next action does
The demo link opens the actual scoped booking flow
The selected foundation fits React and permits the intended open-source distribution
No fake studio customers, testimonials, live bookings, or payment success
Narrow layout, keyboard navigation, focus and relevant state transitions are checked
